description_expanded: This lovely 3,400 square foot vacation home in the exclusive Gulf Trace neighborhood of Grayton Beach has four bedrooms with the ability to sleep up to 14 fortunate guests. This private piece of paradise is perfect for your next beach reunion with family and friends since there are separate guest quarters on all three levels. It also comes with a gorgeous swimming pool that measures 37'x12' and wraps all the way around the back of the house. The pool patio is lushly landscaped with tropical palms, live oak trees and flowering oleanders that make for an enchanting secluded retreat. A grill, lounge chairs, and a table invite you to enjoy poolside dining and family cookouts. Above the Dunes is only 100 yards from the sugar white sand, so you have the best of both worlds!  A columned screened veranda, an open second-floor balcony, and a rooftop deck all look down upon the beautiful pool below. A Great Room encompasses the open living, dining and kitchen areas and has double glass doors that provide ready access to the poolside veranda. This spacious living area (with queen sleeper sofa) is professionally decorated in a distinct upscale style with contemporary, colorful abstract paintings and tropically inspired decorative arts. Two chic vine patterned accent chairs provide a sitting area in the foyer while an eclectic seating ensemble in the living area includes a creamy white couch, a matching leather chair, a plush blue armchair and a brown leather chair with a matching ottoman. A white custom cabinet with shelving houses a flatscreen TV. The charming dining area has a country hardwood table seating eight with wooden chairs and a leather-backed bench. Four leather bar chairs on the open counter nearby face the Gourmet Kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances that include a gas range and an under counter ice maker for your favorite drinks. It has everything you need to create a fun, festive meal for all. One of the cottage-style Guest Bedrooms is on this level has a comfortable king sized bed and an en-suite bath with a glass-walled walk-in shower. An elegant half bath serves as a convenient powder room off the living area. The Primary Bedroom and two more guest suites are upstairs on the second level. The sunny light Primary Bedroom with white furnishings includes a king sized bed, a sitting area, and a pool balcony. The en-suite luxury bath has double vanities with veined white marble tops, a soaking tub, and a marble-paneled walk-in shower. Both Guest Bedrooms on this level also have private en-suite baths. One of these has a lovely queen sized bed and balcony access while the other includes bunks with a twin above a full sized bed. The comfortably furnished third floor Tower Room with a queen sleeper sofa has walls of windows on each side, a 72" TV, a Wet Bar and double glass doors that lead out to a rooftop that wraps around its sides for views of the gulf in the distance.   This heavenly South Walton location is minutes away from restaurants, friendly beach bars, shopping and delightful diversions nearby along Scenic 30A . First Floor: Living Room with Queen Sleeper Sofa, Dining, Kitchen, King Bedroom with Walk-In Shower, Powder Room. Second Floor: King Primary Suite with Twin Futon + Walk-In Shower and Garden Tub, Queen Bedroom with Tub/Shower Combo, Bunk Room with Full/Twin Bunk and Walk-In Shower. Third Floor: Bonus Den with Queen Sleeper Sofa, Wet Bar, and Balcony Access. Boats, golf carts, storage trailers, and recreational vehicles are not permitted. *Add $50.00 per day to the heat pool & hot tub (available Oct-April if needed)
